# Fixed strings law/engineering-law.md must carry, one per line; read by tests/short-law.test.sh.
# A line starting with # is a comment. Add a pin here whenever a rule is added to the short law.
# caps
40 lines per function
3 parameters
3 levels of nesting
500 lines per file
# bans
`biome-ignore`
`eslint-disable`
`@ts-ignore`
`@ts-expect-error`
`@ts-nocheck`
`istanbul ignore`
`c8 ignore`
`v8 ignore`
non-null `!`
`catch (e) {}`
`.catch(() => {})`
`except: pass`
discarded into `_`
inline `interface` or `type` of 2+ properties
`*.types`
`TypeError`
`RangeError`
`RuntimeException`
`Promise.reject(new Error(...))`
`.only`
`fit`
`fdescribe`
`.skip`
`xit`
`xdescribe`
`test.todo`
`debugger`
`console.*`
# one thing per file
`*.constants`
`*.config`
`*.schema`
`*.styles`
read 2.2 before creating any file or folder
# principles
second caller
paste the search that found none
Leave nothing behind
Dead code that was there before your change is a follow-up
# clean-code floor
does or answers, never both
No flag parameters
Never mutate inputs
Fail fast at the boundary
One level of abstraction per function
Talk to what you hold
keeps its cause and context
awaited, returned or handled
Composition before inheritance
A closed set is a type
# refuse on sight
Add error handling later
a `TODO` with no owner
commented-out code
zero references
# performance guardrails
Never query or call per loop item
Parallelize independent I/O
Bound every result set
Bound every cache
Bound every fan-out
No sync blocking I/O
Filter on indexes
No O(n²) on unbounded input
Batch bulk writes
Stream large payloads
Stable props and keys in UI hot paths
before optimizing
# git safety
`git checkout -- <path>`
`git restore`
`git stash`
`git reset --hard`
`git clean`
`git push --force`
`git add -A`
`git add .`
`git commit -a`
`--no-verify`
`--amend`
No AI attribution in commits
# never say
"should work"
"looks good"
"I believe this is fine"
"tests should pass"
"I'll add tests later"
"probably"
"you're absolutely right"
# the six deploy proofs and the live check
green on the exact commit being shipped
booted against a production-like copy
switches that default off
rolled back cleanly
no regression with the switch off
the rollback named
verify live
# claims
Code is the only source of truth
planted instance
Memory is a hypothesis
search for the family
find every reader
name the tier
did not reach
# questions and decisions
`AskUserQuestion`
`(Recommended)`
most effective fix
`advisor`
never by a number
# one goal, pace, principles
exactly one main goal
`file:line`
Drift check
Read the whole thing
Finish the whole task
Every detail the user gave
Think before coding
Simplicity first
Surgical changes
Goal-driven execution
→ verify:
# precedence and helpers
This law is the floor
the stricter rule wins
Never waivable
never a `fork`
# never chase what you find on the way
Never chase what you find on the way
told to the user at once
already red before your change
still stops the deploy
Not reasons:
it cuts tokens or drift
the members the goal names get fixed
never hunks of this diff
